title: A transition carries the sound across the cut too
goal: Put a dissolve between two clips and the picture blends, but the sound still jumps from one clip to the next at the edit point, so the exported video has a hard audio cut, often a click, right in the middle of a smooth picture change. A Final Cut editor expects the dissolve to cross-fade the sound as well, and a Premiere editor applies both with one key. Make a transition on a cut blend the two clips' own sound over the same stretch, in playback and in the exported file.
notes: From the audit rough line in queue/audits/2026-09-23-transition-picker-at-a-cut.json: 'Transitions between clips only change the picture: the sound still cuts hard at the edit point.' Checked by reading, 2026-09-24: ClipTransitions.swift (PhotonzCore) is picture only, and AudioMix.swift / DocumentAudioPlayer.swift / DocumentMovieWriter.swift never mention a transition. Not reproduced by ear (the probe cannot listen), so this is a gap to build, not a p1 bug. Linked sound segments come from a-clip-s-sound-is-on-the-timeline-from-the-momen; volume ramps already exist in AudioMix. No new control: the existing transition drives it.
acceptance: At Next defaults, open the sample talk, cut it, drop the b-roll after it, click the join and pick Dissolve: playing across the join, the sound of the first clip fades out while the second fades in over the transition's length, instead of switching at the edit point
The exported MP4 has the same blend (a test reads the mixed samples either side of the edit point and finds no step)
A cut with no transition still cuts the sound where it cuts the picture, and a dip to black dips the sound with it
Sound on its own track that is not linked to either clip (music) is not touched
Tests on the mix plan are written before the code
anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: a Premiere editor expects Cross Dissolve to bring a Constant Power audio crossfade, and FCP's dissolve uses a +3dB (equal power) fade, so overlap kinds cross-fade equal-power, running the outgoing sound on into its spare and starting the incoming early (the same spare the picture spends). Dips take the sound through silence with the picture. A continuous cut (plain split, same frames both sides) is left alone for sound: the two readings are the same samples, so any cross-fade would only colour them. Traps found: the live player keys its level by LAYER, so two overlapping pieces of one clip (a dissolve on a join inside a clip) would share one fader; each segment now says which voice of its layer it is. Sound detached onto its own layer is no longer linked and is not touched. No mock change: no new control, the existing transition drives it.

Built: Sources/PhotonzCore/TransitionSound.swift reshapes audioMix() at every drawn transition (joins and edit points). Overlap kinds: run-on/early start from spare + equal-power cos/sin ramps. Dips: linear to silence on the cut. Continuous cut + overlap kind untouched. AudioMixSegment.voice added; DocumentAudioPlayer keys faders by (layer, voice); AudioHeadroom.limited carries voice. Tests: TransitionSoundTests (12, written first), TransitionSoundExportTests (3, reads the written file: hard cut steps >0.3, dissolve and dip never step >20% of level in 40 ms). Walk: transition-carries-the-sound-walk with new actions clipPickEditPoint + soundExpectCutCarried, no flags, no front; ok. Dissolve on the cut reads 0.71/0.71, dip 1.00 -> 0.01, hard cut switches at 7000 ms. All 8 sound walks and 5 transition walks ok; full suite 10156 green.

left rough (audit rough, not filed): the Audio lane draws the linked sound pieces butting at the cut with no mark of the cross-fade or the 0.2s run-on. The mock draws the sound as one plain bar and no open task covers it; the user can react to the rough line. Also no audio-only transition or keep-sound-hard option; nobody asked for it.

A transition on a cut now shapes the sound in the one mix plan both playback and export read (Sources/PhotonzCore/TransitionSound.swift). Dissolve, push, wipe and blur cross-fade the two clips' sound at equal power over their length, using the same spare media the picture spends. Dips go through silence on the cut. A cut with no transition still switches the sound on the cut, and unlinked music and detached sound are untouched. Verified: TransitionSoundTests (12, written first); TransitionSoundExportTests reads the exported file back and finds no step at the edit point with a dissolve or a dip, and a clear step with a hard cut; transition-carries-the-sound-walk at Next defaults reads 0.71/0.71 on the cut for a dissolve and 1.00 to 0.01 for a dip. All 13 sound and transition walks ok; full suite 10156 green. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-27-transition-carries-the-sound.json. Commit c3209b01.
